added.summary: Add keyed full, fractional and depleted resource pips; boss health with named current/completed/upcoming phases and invulnerable/defeated/loading states; and game-driven combo count, fractional multiplier and remaining-window displays. Parts and tokens support style packs; labels wrap at phone widths.

Add signed pickup logs with keyed entries, wrapping names/details and loading/empty states, and supplied FPS, fractional frame time, ping and packet-loss readings with distinct unknown and connection states. Games own feed expiry and measurement thresholds.
